question: Tanjore paintings originated in the time of which dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Cholas.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tanjore paintings** are a form of classical South Indian painting that originated in **Tanjore**, a city in Tamil Nadu, during the **Chola dynasty** (around the 9th to 12th centuries).
 
• The Chola dynasty was known for its rich contributions to art, architecture, and culture, significantly influencing the development of Tanjore paintings.
 
• Tanjore paintings are characterized by their **rich colors, intricate details, and use of gold foil**, which adds a unique luminosity to the artwork.
 
• This traditional art form typically depicts **Hindu deities**, religious themes, and scenes from mythology, reflecting the spiritual and cultural ethos of the time.
 
• In 2007, awarded **Geographical Indication (GI) rights by the Government of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Techniques and Materials**: Tanjore paintings are made using a technique that involves applying a base layer of wood or canvas followed by the use of **natural pigments** and **gold leaf** for embellishment.
 
• **Patronage**: The art form flourished under the patronage of the Chola rulers, who supported artists and craftsmen, helping to preserve and promote the artistic heritage of the region.
 
• **Contemporary Revival**: In recent years, there has been a revival of interest in Tanjore paintings, with artists and artisans working to keep the tradition alive while also incorporating modern themes and techniques.
 
• **Cultural Significance**: Tanjore paintings are not only valued for their aesthetic beauty but also serve as important cultural artifacts, reflecting the historical and spiritual narratives of South India.
